headline: Bodhi Tree Multimedia submits EGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Post-EGM voting results now on record
summary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has submitted its scrutinizer's report and voting results for the Extraordinary General Meeting held on October 28, 2026, to the stock exchange. This filing completes the post-meeting compliance routine for the company. Indian retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap firm can review the finalized voting outcomes on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate price impact.

headline: Bodhi Tree Multimedia schedules extraordinary general meeting for October 2026
hook: Upcoming vote for Bodhi Tree stakeholders
summary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has announced an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for October 28, 2026. The company formally notified the stock exchange regarding the upcoming shareholder gathering. Specific agenda details for the meeting were not disclosed in the filing. Retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap media firm should monitor subsequent disclosures for resolution details.
why_it_matters: Corporate decisions at the EGM may impact share value.
